mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_GLUE_COLLECT_PLAN_LOG (ID, DEMAND_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, PLAN_DATE, FACTORY, GLUE, MIX_AREA, MACHINE_CODE, TOTAL_PLAN_QTY, LAST_SURPLUS, MID_PLAN_QTY, MID_REMARK, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_REMARK, DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_REMARK, DATA_SOURCE, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME) SELECT ID, DEMAND_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, PLAN_DATE, FACTORY, GLUE, MIX_AREA, MACHINE_CODE, TOTAL_PLAN_QTY, LAST_SURPLUS, MID_PLAN_QTY, MID_REMARK, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_REMARK, DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_REMARK, DATA_SOURCE, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME FROM T_GLUE_COLLECT_PLAN WHERE plan_date = #{planDate}

INSERT INTO T_GLUE_COLLECT_PLAN(ID, DEMAND_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, PLAN_DATE, MIX_AREA, GLUE, FACTORY, TOTAL_PLAN_QTY, LAST_SURPLUS, PRODUCE_QTY, MID_PLAN_QTY, MID_REMARK, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_REMARK, DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_REMARK, DATA_SOURCE, CREATE_BY) SELECT NULL id, m.* FROM ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(distinct BATCH_NO ORDER BY BATCH_NO SEPARATOR ';') AS DEMAND_BATCH_NO, /*对应胶料需求计划批次号*/ #{batchNo} BATCH_NO, /*批次号*/ PLAN_DATE, /*计划日期*/ MIX_AREA, /*密炼区*/ GLUE, /*胶料*/ GROUP_CONCAT(distinct FACTORY ORDER BY FACTORY SEPARATOR ',') AS FACTORY, /*分厂*/ SUM(ifnull(TOTAL_PLAN_QTY, 0)) TOTAL_PLAN_QTY, /*日计划*/ 0 LAST_SURPLUS, /*昨日剩余*/ SUM(ifnull(TOTAL_PLAN_QTY, 0)) PRODUCE_QTY, /*生产量*/ SUM(ifnull(MID_PLAN_QTY, 0)) MID_PLAN_QTY, /*中班计划量*/ GROUP_CONCAT(distinct MID_REMARK ORDER BY MID_REMARK SEPARATOR ';') AS MID_REMARK, /*中班备注*/ SUM(ifnull(NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, 0)) NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, /*夜班计划量*/ GROUP_CONCAT(distinct NIGHT_REMARK ORDER BY NIGHT_REMARK SEPARATOR ';') AS NIGHT_REMARK, /*夜班备注*/ SUM(ifnull(DAY_PLAN_QTY, 0)) DAY_PLAN_QTY, /*白班计划量*/ GROUP_CONCAT(distinct DAY_REMARK ORDER BY DAY_REMARK SEPARATOR ';') AS DAY_REMARK, /*白班备注*/ '0' DATA_SOURCE, /*数据来源：汇总计划*/ #{createBy} CREATE_BY FROM T_GLUE_DEMAND_PLAN where plan_date = #{planDate} and DEL_FLAG = '0' group by PLAN_DATE, MIX_AREA, GLUE ) m
mapper.update: update T_GLUE_COLLECT_PLAN p join (SELECT MIX_AREA, GLUE, (case when instr(MACHINE_CODE, ',') = 0 then MACHINE_CODE else substr(MACHINE_CODE, 1, instr(MACHINE_CODE, ',') - 1) end) as machine_code /*如果有多个机台，则只拿第一个机台*/ FROM (SELECT f.MIX_AREA, f.GLUE, group_concat(distinct f.MACHINE_CODE order by f.MACHINE_ORDER SEPARATOR ',') AS MACHINE_CODE /*机台根据机台顺序升序排序*/ FROM T_FORMULA_MACHINE f INNER JOIN T_MIX_MACHINE m1 ON f.machine_code = m1.machine_code and m1.status = '0' and m1.del_flag = '0' AND (m1.mid_status = '0' OR m1.night_status = '0' OR m1.day_status = '0') WHERE f.DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY f.MIX_AREA, f.GLUE) fm) m on (p.glue = m.glue and p.mix_area = m.mix_area) set p.MACHINE_CODE = m.MACHINE_CODE where p.del_flag = '0' and p.plan_date = #{planDate}

update T_GLUE_COLLECT_PLAN p join (SELECT d.MIX_AREA, d.GLUE, group_concat(distinct d.MACHINE_CODE order by d.MACHINE_CODE SEPARATOR ',') AS MACHINE_CODE /*密炼机台*/ FROM T_MACHINE_GLUE_DECOMPOSE d INNER JOIN T_MIX_MACHINE m on d.machine_code = m.machine_code and m.DEL_FLAG = '0' and m.STATUS = '0' AND (m.mid_status = '0' OR m.night_status = '0' OR m.day_status = '0') WHERE d.DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY d.MIX_AREA, d.GLUE) m on (p.glue = m.glue and p.mix_area = m.mix_area) set p.MACHINE_CODE = m.MACHINE_CODE where p.del_flag = '0' and p.plan_date = #{planDate}

update T_GLUE_COLLECT_PLAN p join (SELECT SCHEDULE_DATE as SCHEDULE_DATE, /*计划日期*/ MIX_AREA, GLUE, SUM(ifnull(TOTAL_SURPLUS, 0)) as TOTAL_SURPLUS /*总剩余*/ FROM T_GLUE_SCHEDULE_RESULT WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY SCHEDULE_DATE, MIX_AREA, GLUE ) m on (p.PLAN_DATE = DATE_ADD(m.SCHEDULE_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY) and p.MIX_AREA = m.MIX_AREA and p.GLUE = m.GLUE) set p.PRODUCE_QTY=ifnull(m.TOTAL_SURPLUS, 0) + ifnull(p.TOTAL_PLAN_QTY, 0), p.LAST_SURPLUS = m.TOTAL_SURPLUS where p.del_flag = '0' and p.plan_date = str_to_date(#{planDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')

mapper.update: insert into T_GLUE_UNCLAIMED (SCHEDULE_DATE, MIX_AREA, GLUE, SHELF_NUM1, SHELF_NUM2, CREATE_TIME) select * from (SELECT P.PLAN_DATE, P.MIX_AREA, P.GLUE, CASE WHEN ifnull(P.TOTAL_PLAN_QTY, 0) > ifnull(S.SHELF_NUM, 0) THEN ifnull(P.TOTAL_PLAN_QTY, 0) - ifnull(S.SHELF_NUM, 0) ELSE 0 END SHELF_NUM, 0, now() FROM T_GLUE_COLLECT_PLAN P LEFT JOIN (SELECT S.SCHEDULE_DATE, S.MIX_AREA, S.MATERIAL_NAME, SUM(S.SHELF_NUM) SHELF_NUM FROM T_MES_PPM_RUBBER_STORE_OUT S WHERE S.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{planDate} AND S.DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY S.SCHEDULE_DATE, S.MIX_AREA, S.MATERIAL_NAME) S ON P.PLAN_DATE = S.SCHEDULE_DATE AND P.GLUE = S.MATERIAL_NAME AND P.MIX_AREA = S.MIX_AREA WHERE P.PLAN_DATE = #{planDate} AND P.DEL_FLAG = '0' UNION SELECT U.SCHEDULE_DATE, U.MIX_AREA, U.GLUE, 0, 0, now() FROM T_GLUE_UNCLAIMED U WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 0 FROM T_GLUE_COLLECT_PLAN P WHERE P.PLAN_DATE = U.SCHEDULE_DATE AND P.GLUE = U.GLUE AND P.MIX_AREA = U.MIX_AREA AND P.DEL_FLAG = '0') AND U.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{planDate} AND U.DEL_FLAG = '0') as tb on duplicate key update SHELF_NUM1 = values(SHELF_NUM1), UPDATE_TIME = now()
